answer: To achieve Sybil resistance, an AI agent network enforces hardware-bound proof-of-collateral where each agent must harbor a unique physical enclave key and stake tokens. Agents continuously compute a cryptographic liveness pulse validated via zero-knowledge proofs. If an adversary attempts to spawn clone identities without acquiring distinct physical enclaves, the system detects duplicate telemetry and demotes suspected nodes to an umber quarantine state, slashing their staked assets and elevating the marginal capital cost of identity creation beyond potential attack yields.
